fields.label: What must the proposed specification change?

risks.mitigation: Add one focused Oakridge DBOS test invocation for run-config, observation-mapping, and observation-publisher, or require the assessor to label T1 test evidence as indirect.

risks.description: PR #791 is already merged and the current epic/grade-pray ref has advanced beyond its historical base, so inspecting the current base would not reproduce the requested subject.

risks.description: The observation integration suite depends on local database/runtime availability and may be unable to run in the isolated worker environment.

body.summary: The audit is implementable as a read-only verification of PR #791 head db2a5d49b8fbcaff9faf03094ddd0757b9c9ecef, with exactly the named audit cohort and tasks T1 and T2. Static repository evidence supports grading_enabled defaulting off and traveling with ordered launch delivery, exact-claim fencing, and transactional completion plus observation append. There are no blocking or ambiguous requirements. One warning remains: the sole mandated observation-package test run directly covers T2 but does not execute the existing Oakridge DBOS tests for T1.

findings.description: The builder verification command is scoped to observation tests: observation/package.json:6-8 maps it to bun test ./tests. T1 has direct behavior coverage outside that package in oakridge-dbos/tests/run-config.test.ts:56-83, oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-mapping.test.ts:50-65, and oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-publisher.test.ts:177-209. Therefore the mandated run can supply only indirect test evidence for T1, even though the assessor must attach test or output evidence to a T1 finding.

T1 is concretely verifiable at the target commit: oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts:7-41 gives RunConfig a boolean grading_enabled, defaults an omitted value to false, rejects non-booleans, and preserves the parsed choice; oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts:42-49 emits the committed config beside launch input. The ordered publisher reads the launch config only for the launched event and advances one acknowledged cursor at a time in oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation.ts:13-45.

T2 claim fencing is exact and lock-safe: observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:196-228 predicates status, lease owner, claim attempt, and unexpired database-time lease, locks before rereading, and fences the authoritative update again. observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:304-358 covers expired, reclaimed, older-attempt, and lock-wait expiry cases with no stale writes.

T2 completion atomicity and worker propagation are explicit: observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:267-293 settles the execution and inserts grade_observation inside one withTenant transaction, while observation/src/grading/worker.ts:71-95 passes the same ExecutionClaim through request marking and completion/failure. observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:231-244 proves an invalid observation append rolls back completion and a valid append commits exactly one completed execution and answer.

requirements.description: Produce at least three distinct analysis findings, then exactly one cohort named audit with exactly tasks T1 and T2 in later artifacts.
T1 audits grading_enabled from launch config, default false when absent, through ordered launch delivery at the specified PR head.
T2 audits settlement fencing to the exact current claim and atomic execution completion plus observation append at the specified PR head.
Builder performs no edits or remote mutations, detaches the named origin branch, runs the required observation test command once, reports actual output, and publishes existing PR #791.
Assessor evaluates the same recorded commit, gives at least one finding per task with path:start-end code evidence and separate test/output evidence, and reports builder test output as test_evidence.

source_spec_refs: Artifact topology: exactly one audit cohort with tasks T1 and T2
T1 launch grading configuration and ordered delivery
T2 exact-claim settlement fencing and transactional observation append
Builder read-only checkout, test, build_result, and existing-PR publication instructions
Assessor same-commit code and test evidence requirements

proposed_spec_updates.change: After bun run --filter observation test, require one additional focused run at the detached head: bun test oakridge-dbos/tests/run-config.test.ts oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-mapping.test.ts oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-publisher.test.ts. Record its actual counts and output separately, with inability to run treated as a known issue under the same no-invention rule.
proposed_spec_updates.reason: The currently required observation-package command does not execute the direct parser, mapping, or end-to-end ordered launch delivery tests for T1, yet the assessor must provide test or output evidence for that task.
